questions.text: Before applying a threshold, a perceptron computes:

options.a: the average of the input features
options.c: a weighted sum plus a bias, w dot x + b
options.d: a probability distribution over all labels

questions.text: What is the main role of the bias term b?

options.d: to remove the need for training data

questions.text: In two input dimensions, the boundary w dot x + b = 0 is a:
When a perceptron update is made after a mistake, the weights move:

options.a: in a direction that increases the same mistake
options.b: only by setting every weight to zero
options.d: toward correctly scoring that labeled example

questions.text: Why does this module matter for later neural networks?

options.a: because GPTs use hard perceptron thresholds at every layer
options.b: because linear units alone can solve every classification problem
options.c: because affine maps are reused inside MLPs, attention projections, and output heads
options.d: because it removes the need for nonlinear functions
